name: Neon Goalkeeper VR
summary:
Take your place between the posts in Neon Goalkeeper VR, a fast, stationary VR soccer challenge built around reflexes, positioning, and clean saves.

Move both Touch controllers to control your cyan and magenta goalkeeper gloves. React to driven, arcing, bouncing, and rolling football shots aimed across the goal. Every save earns points; chain consecutive saves to increase your multiplier up to x5. Let a shot in and your streak resets. You have three lives and 90 seconds to set your best score.

Choose Easy
